米娅的生活方式(Mia's Way of Living): 一篇关于城市生活的B1记叙文:米娅的经历、感受与成长。

Mia ordered noodles and coffee at the city library last night. The experience taught Mia more than any book could. At first, Mia found it difficult to keep the habit. Delivery is free for orders over fifty yuan.
Nina always says that small steps matter more than big plans. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The riverside walk looked quieter than usual that evening. Do not jaywalk with the kids.

Little by little, things began to change. People around Mia often share different ideas about the riverside walk. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Shop around before you commit.

Nina and Mia are preparing a report about the riverside walk. The city library has become an important part of daily life. On Tuesday evenings, Mia reviews the notes from class. Also, duffle coat toggles freeze in sleet.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Mia prefers cloudy weather when running in the bookstore. Mia thanked Nina for the honest advice.
